Our technicians

### Experienced Samsung Service Center Technicians & Get Quality Repair Service

An appliance failure rarely arrives at a convenient moment. It brings unwelcome disruption and an unexpected cost, which makes choosing the right people the most important decision you will make that day. When disaster strikes, you need a team you can trust.

At Samsung Service Center, we are a team of experienced, skilled and licensed technicians with a wealth of industry experience. Each specialist completes extensive training to meet strict safety and technical standards. We stay up to date with the latest repair techniques and use our expertise to provide effective, long-lasting solutions, arriving equipped to handle everything from a routine service call to a complex breakdown.

#### Samsung Washing Machine Repair

A Samsung washing machine repair usually starts with the symptom you can hear: a drum that will not turn, a spin that shakes the floor, or water still sitting in the tub after the cycle. We trace it to the pump, the bearings, the door lock or the board before anything is replaced, and every replacement is a genuine Samsung part .

#### Samsung Air Conditioner Repair

A UAE summer gives an air conditioner no rest, which is why Samsung AC repair is what we are called out for most between May and September. Split, window and ducted units are all covered. The calls we get are warm air, cooling that fades by the afternoon, water running down the wall, and an outdoor unit that keeps tripping the breaker.

#### Samsung Refrigerator Repair

A warm fridge is the fault that cannot wait. Samsung refrigerator repair covers French-door, side-by-side, Family Hub and Bespoke models: uneven cooling, frost sheeting the back panel, water under the salad drawer, a silent ice maker, and the sealed system behind all of them.

#### Samsung Microwave Oven Repair

A microwave is the one appliance never to open yourself, because its capacitor can hold a dangerous charge long after the plug is out. Samsung microwave oven repair begins with that safety check, then the door interlocks, the turntable drive and the heating circuit that has stopped doing its job.

#### Samsung Dishwasher Repair

Plates coming out gritty, or standing water in the base after every programme? Samsung dishwasher repair is usually a clogged filter, a tired drain pump or a spray arm that has stopped turning, and nearly all of it is diagnosed and finished in the kitchen the machine stands in.

#### Samsung Cooking Range and Oven Repair

Gas and electric are two different jobs, and Samsung cooking range and oven repair covers both: an oven that never reaches temperature, a grill that stays cold, a burner that clicks without catching. Gas work is undertaken only where the appliance and its installation can be handled safely.

#### Samsung Dryer Repair

When the cycle ends and the clothes are still damp, the answer is almost always airflow. Samsung tumble dryer repair takes in the lint filter, the condenser or heat-pump block, the drum belt and rollers, and the moisture sensors that decide when to stop.

Not sure which one it is?

Describe the symptom and the technician will tell you what it usually turns out to be.

In detail

### We Service & Repair All Samsung Appliances Problems

This section covers the common problems found in Samsung home appliances, the areas inspected during diagnosis and practical steps that can reduce avoidable faults.

#### Samsung Washing Machine Service for Drum and Drain Faults

##### Common Samsung Washing Machine Problems

Common washing machine problems include the appliance not starting, the programme stopping before completion, the drum not spinning or turning inconsistently, water not entering the machine, water remaining inside the drum, clothes remaining unusually wet, water leaking from the door, hose or lower section, the door not locking or opening correctly, excessive movement during the spin cycle, detergent remaining in the drawer, banging, humming or grinding noises, a burning smell, a blank or unresponsive display and an error message appearing on the control panel.

##### What We Inspect and Repair on a Washing Machine

Our washing machine service may include inspection of the water inlet, inlet hoses, detergent drawer, drain filter, drainage hose, drain pump, drum movement, drive system, door lock, water-level sensing, electrical connections and control panel.

The technician determines whether the problem can be resolved through cleaning or adjustment, or whether a damaged component requires repair or replacement. Once the approved work has been completed, the relevant filling, washing, drainage and spin functions are tested.

##### Washing Machine Care Tips

Avoid overloading the drum because excessive weight can place additional strain on the suspension, bearings and drive system. Use the amount and type of detergent recommended for the machine, as excessive detergent can leave residue and contribute to drainage or odour problems.

Check clothing pockets for coins, pins and other small objects before starting a programme. Clean the accessible drain filter at the intervals recommended in the appliance manual, and leave the door slightly open after use so that trapped moisture can escape.

Stop using the appliance if it develops a serious leak, visible smoke, a burning smell or a sudden mechanical noise. Continuing to operate a damaged washing machine can affect additional components and increase the extent of the repair.

#### Samsung Air Conditioner Service When Cooling Drops Off

##### Common Samsung Air Conditioner Problems

Common air-conditioner problems include the unit not switching on, warm or insufficiently cool air, cooling that weakens during operation, weak airflow, water leaking from the indoor unit, ice forming on the indoor coil or pipework, the outdoor unit not starting, the system repeatedly stopping, unusual rattling or buzzing noises, unpleasant odours, the remote control not responding, the display remaining blank and an error message appearing on the unit.

##### What We Inspect and Repair on an Air Conditioner

An air-conditioner visit can take in the electrical supply, filters, indoor coil, outdoor coil, drainage line, fan operation, temperature sensors, control board, capacitor and communication between the indoor and outdoor units.

Blocked filters and drainage lines can often be cleaned, while failed electrical or mechanical components may require repair or replacement. When a refrigerant, compressor or sealed-system fault is suspected, appropriate testing is required before any further work is recommended.

The system is tested after the approved repair to confirm that it starts, produces airflow, responds to the controls and drains condensation correctly.

##### Air Conditioner Care Tips

Clean or replace accessible filters according to the manufacturer’s guidance, and keep furniture, curtains and stored items away from the indoor air inlet and outlet.

Do not continue running the unit if water is leaking near an electrical connection, the circuit breaker repeatedly trips or ice forms heavily on the pipework. Switching the system off can help prevent further damage while the cause is investigated.

A dirty filter can reduce airflow, but not every cooling problem is caused by dirt or low refrigerant. Electrical, sensor, airflow and compressor faults can produce similar symptoms and should be diagnosed before parts or refrigerant are added.

#### Samsung Refrigerator Service for Frost and Warm Shelves

##### Common Samsung Refrigerator Problems

Common refrigerator problems include insufficient cooling, the freezer not maintaining a freezing temperature, the refrigerator compartment remaining warm while the freezer stays cold, unstable temperatures, water collecting inside the cabinet, water leaking underneath the appliance, excessive frost on an internal panel, continuous operation without reaching the selected temperature, the ice maker not producing ice, the water dispenser not working, clicking, buzzing or vibrating noises, a door that does not close properly, an inaccurate temperature display, a blank or unresponsive screen and a defrost problem.

##### What We Inspect and Repair Inside a Refrigerator

A refrigerator service may cover the temperature settings, internal airflow, door seals, air vents, fans, drainage path, defrost system, temperature sensors, electrical connections, compressor operation and electronic controls.

Whether the fix is cleaning, adjustment, electrical repair, cooling-system work or a replacement component is settled at that point. The refrigerator is checked after the repair, although the internal temperature may require several hours to stabilise.

Instructions may be provided for monitoring the temperature after service. Food should not be returned to unsafe storage conditions until the refrigerator and freezer have recovered sufficiently.

##### Refrigerator Care Tips

Leave suitable ventilation space around the appliance and keep internal air vents clear of food packages. Overfilling the cabinet can restrict airflow and create uneven temperatures.

Check that shelves, drawers and containers do not prevent the doors from closing. Damaged or dirty seals may allow warm air to enter, leading to moisture, frost and longer compressor operation.

Allow very hot food to cool appropriately before placing it inside the refrigerator. If cooling stops, move perishable food to safe storage and limit unnecessary door opening until the fault has been assessed.

#### Samsung Microwave Oven Service When the Heat Stops

##### Common Samsung Microwave Problems

Common microwave problems include the appliance not switching on, the display remaining blank, the controls not responding, the microwave running without heating food, the turntable not rotating, the interior light not working, the door not closing or latching correctly, unusual buzzing sounds, sparks or arcing inside the cooking chamber, a burning smell and an error message appearing on the display.

##### What We Inspect and Repair in a Microwave Oven

On a microwave we may check the power supply, plug, internal fuse, door-latch mechanism, safety interlocks, control panel, turntable system, internal waveguide cover and heating circuit.

Microwave ovens contain high-voltage components that can retain a dangerous electrical charge after the appliance has been disconnected. Internal testing and repair should therefore be carried out only by a person with the appropriate skills and equipment.

After the approved repair, the door safety system, controls, turntable and heating operation are tested using suitable procedures.

##### Microwave Care Tips

Use microwave-safe containers and avoid placing metal objects or unsuitable foil inside the cooking chamber. Clean food residue and grease after the appliance has cooled, particularly around the door and internal waveguide cover.

Do not operate the microwave when it is empty, and do not continue using it if the door is damaged, sparks appear inside the chamber or a burning smell develops.

The outer casing should not be removed for household cleaning or troubleshooting because the internal high-voltage system can remain hazardous even when the microwave is unplugged.

#### Samsung Dishwasher Service for Dirty Dishes and Standing Water

##### Common Samsung Dishwasher Problems

Common dishwasher problems include the appliance not switching on, water not entering, water remaining inside after the programme, dishes coming out dirty or covered with residue, dishes remaining wet, water leaking from the door or base, spray arms not rotating, the detergent dispenser not opening, the door not closing or locking correctly, humming or grinding noises, an unpleasant smell, a blank or unresponsive display and an error message appearing during the wash cycle.

##### What We Inspect and Repair in a Dishwasher

A dishwasher service can include the water inlet, inlet hose, filters, spray arms, circulation system, drainage path, drain pump, door seal, door latch, detergent dispenser, heating function, sensors and electronic controls.

The appliance is checked for blockages, leaks, damaged components and incorrect operation. Following the approved repair, the dishwasher is tested to confirm that it fills, circulates water and drains correctly.

##### Dishwasher Care Tips

Remove large food particles before loading dishes, and clean the accessible filter regularly. Food debris can restrict drainage, affect spray pressure and create unpleasant odours.

Load plates, pans and utensils so that they do not prevent the spray arms from turning. Use detergent made specifically for dishwashers and follow the recommended dosage.

Ordinary hand-washing liquid should not be used because it can produce excessive foam and cause leakage or poor operation. Persistent standing water, leakage or electrical tripping should be investigated before the appliance is used again.

#### Samsung Cooking Range and Oven Service for Burner Faults

##### Common Cooking Range and Oven Problems

Common cooking-appliance problems include the unit not switching on, an oven not heating, slow preheating, inaccurate or unstable temperatures, food cooking unevenly, a grill function not working, an electric element remaining cold, a gas burner not igniting, continuous ignition clicking, an unstable flame, the flame going out during use, unresponsive controls, a blank display, a door that does not close correctly, a loose or damaged door seal, a self-cleaning function not operating and a temperature or door-lock error appearing on the panel.

##### What We Inspect and Repair on a Cooking Range

Cooking range and oven work may involve the electrical supply, switches, heating elements, ignition system, burners, temperature sensor, thermostat, control panel, door hinges, door seal and locking mechanism.

What the fault needs is established first: a clean, an adjustment, electrical repair or a new component. After the approved work, the relevant heating, ignition, control and door functions are tested.

Gas-related work requires additional care. An appliance should not remain connected for normal use when a gas hose, valve, connection or safety component is suspected to be unsafe.

##### Cooking Range and Oven Care Tips

Clean spills after the appliance has cooled, and keep burner openings clear of food residue. Do not force knobs or switches that have become stiff, and do not use an appliance with a damaged cable, loose plug or overheating socket.

Keep oven vents clear and avoid covering them with foil, trays or cookware. Repeatedly opening the oven door during cooking can reduce temperature stability and increase cooking time.

If you smell gas, turn off the appliance and gas supply where it is safe to do so, ventilate the area and avoid flames or nearby electrical switches. Qualified assistance should be arranged before the appliance is used again.

#### Samsung Dryer Service for Damp Loads and Long Cycles

##### Common Samsung Dryer Problems

Common dryer problems include the appliance not starting, the drum not rotating, the dryer operating without producing enough heat, clothes remaining damp, programmes taking longer than normal, the appliance stopping before the cycle is complete, excessive heat, a burning smell, squeaking, scraping or humming noises, the door not closing or registering correctly, the water container filling unusually quickly, a blank or unresponsive display and an error message appearing on the control panel.

##### What We Inspect and Repair on a Dryer

A dryer service may take in the lint filter, airflow path, condenser or heat-pump area, drum movement, drive belt, rollers, motor, heating system, thermal protection, moisture sensors, temperature sensors, door switch and electronic controls.

From there it is a judgement between cleaning, adjustment, repair and replacement. With the approved work done, the dryer is tested to confirm that the drum turns, airflow is present and the appliance responds correctly to the selected programme.

##### Dryer Care Tips

Clean the lint filter after every drying cycle and maintain the condenser or heat-exchange area in accordance with the appliance manual. Restricted airflow can increase drying time and cause excessive heat.

Do not overload the drum, and avoid placing dripping-wet clothing inside the appliance. Separate heavy fabrics from lightweight items where practical so that the load dries more evenly.

Stop using the dryer if visible smoke, a burning smell or abnormal heat develops. Continuing to run an overheating appliance can damage clothing and internal components and may create a safety risk.

Our promise

### 100% Satisfaction Guaranteed

A repair visit should leave you with clear answers about what has gone wrong and what it will cost. Our technicians explain the fault they find, outline the work it needs and confirm the price before they start, so you approve the job with the full figure in front of you. You can ask questions at any point in the visit. Nothing gets carried out without your agreement, including any extra part that turns out to be needed once the appliance is opened. The way a service is handled matters as much as the working appliance at the end of it, which is why our technicians talk you through each stage in plain language. If any part of the job does not match what we agreed with you, our team comes back and corrects it.

How we work

### Quality Repairs, Long-Lasting Solutions

Our technicians work back to what caused the fault before they fix anything. Treating the symptom on its own tends to bring the same problem back within a few weeks, and the second visit costs you more than getting it right the first time. Every repair follows approved methods, and we fit parts matched to your appliance model so performance stays consistent afterwards. Once the work is done, the technician runs the appliance and checks the repaired function in front of you before closing the job. Eligible repairs carry a written three-month warranty on the parts we replace and the labour involved. That warranty covers the work we carried out, and it does not extend to a separate fault that develops later in the same appliance.

Who we work with

### Locally Trusted Across the UAE

Our team works with homeowners, landlords, property managers and businesses across the UAE, and what each one needs from a repair visit is different. A tenant wants the washing machine running before the weekend. A property manager wants one point of contact handling several units in the same building rather than a new company each time. Customers come back to us because appointments are kept at the time we booked them, technicians are careful inside the home, and the cost quoted on the phone is the cost on the invoice. When you book with our Samsung Service Center, you are dealing with a UAE-based team you can reach again after the technician has left.

Four steps

### How It Works

- 01

#### Share the Appliance Details

Book online or call our service team with the appliance type, the fault you have noticed and the model number. On most Samsung machines that number sits on a sticker inside the door frame or on the rear panel. Tell us your emirate and area too, since that decides which technician covers your booking.

- 02

#### Choose Your Service Time

Pick a slot from the times open in your area. Same-day appointments are usually available for urgent breakdowns. We log the request and assign a technician who works on that appliance category rather than sending whoever is free.

- 03

#### On-Site Diagnosis

The technician arrives inside the booked window and inspects the appliance where it stands. Most faults are diagnosed on site, so your machine stays in your home and does not go to a workshop. If the repair needs a part we do not carry in the van, you are told the wait time for it during the same visit.

- 04

#### Repair and Handover

Once you give the go-ahead, the technician carries out the repair on the spot. Common spare parts are kept in our inventory, which is why most jobs finish in a single visit. Before the technician leaves, you receive an invoice with the parts and the labour listed separately.

Why customers stay with us

### Advantages Of Hiring Authorized Samsung Specialist For Samsung Appliances

#### Care Taken Inside Your Home

Every visit starts with protecting the space around the appliance. Technicians lay a protective sheet before opening a washing machine or dishwasher, since drainage work spills water that stains grout and warps skirting. Heavy units are moved on sliders instead of being dragged across tiles. When the repair is done, the work area is cleaned and any replaced part is taken away with us.

#### 24/7 Emergency Appliance Support

Appliance faults do not wait for business hours, and a refrigerator failing at midnight is a different problem from a dishwasher failing at midnight. Our line stays open through the night so the booking is logged and prioritised for the first slot of the morning. Where a fault carries a safety or spoilage risk, such as a fridge losing cooling with a full load inside, we push it ahead of routine jobs. Full overnight callouts are not something every emirate can be covered for, so the team will tell you honestly on the call whether a technician can reach you before morning.

#### Genuine Samsung Parts

We fit genuine Samsung replacement parts rather than generic equivalents. The difference shows up later: a compatible-looking board or pump from an unbranded supplier often runs at slightly different tolerances, which shortens the life of the components around it. Genuine parts also keep your appliance eligible for any manufacturer coverage still running on it. If a part is not held in our inventory, we order it and give you the expected arrival date before you commit to the repair.

#### Samsung Specialists, Not a General Repair Company

Most repair companies in the UAE cover every brand on the market. We work on Samsung home appliances only. A technician who sees the same range of machines every day recognises a fault pattern faster and carries the right spares in the van more often, which is the main reason our single-visit completion rate is high.

Pricing

### Samsung Appliance Repair Costs

The cost of repairing a Samsung appliance depends on the appliance type, the fault found, the time required and the replacement component.

Cleaning a blockage, correcting an adjustment or repairing a minor connection will generally cost less than replacing a motor, compressor, electronic control board or major heating component. Similar symptoms can result from different faults, so a reliable estimate is usually prepared after inspection.

A repair estimate may include:

- A diagnostic or inspection charge
- Labour for the approved repair
- The cost of the replacement component
- Workshop or transportation charges where required
- Applicable taxes
- Any warranty provided with the completed work

A low initial estimate should not be presented as a final price when the appliance has not yet been inspected. Any material change to the estimate should be explained before additional work proceeds.

Three Samsung service centres cover the UAE, and the technician who visits you is dispatched from the nearest one.

Questions

### Questions Our Customers Ask Us Most

Is Samsung Services Center an authorised Samsung service centre?

Yes. That authorisation covers Samsung home appliances in the UAE, across the laundry, cooling and kitchen ranges.

Are repairs completed at the customer’s property?

Many washing machine, refrigerator, air-conditioner, dishwasher, dryer, oven and cooking-range repairs can be completed where the appliance is installed.

A workshop inspection may be recommended when specialised equipment, prolonged testing or work that cannot be completed safely at the property is required.

What replacement parts are used?

The part should be matched to the appliance’s full model code and the confirmed fault. Genuine Samsung parts are used, and the proposed component and its cost are explained before installation.

The part description should also appear on the invoice or service record.

Does every repair include a three-month warranty?

Only where the written service terms or the invoice say so. The document should identify which repair or component the cover applies to.

A warranty on one repair does not normally cover an unrelated fault, accidental damage, misuse or another component that fails later.

What does “screen no display” mean?

“Screen no display” generally means that the appliance display remains blank, does not illuminate or does not respond to the controls.

Possible causes include a loss of electrical supply, a loose or damaged connection, a failed display panel or a fault in the main electronic control system. Testing is required to determine the actual cause.

What is included in appliance maintenance?

Maintenance depends on the appliance. It may include cleaning accessible filters, checking drainage paths, inspecting door seals, reviewing airflow, checking visible electrical connections and testing basic performance.

It is upkeep, not insurance: a part unrelated to the work can still fail afterwards.

Should a faulty appliance be repaired or replaced?

Repair may be reasonable when the appliance remains in good general condition, the required part is available and the expected cost is substantially lower than replacement.

Replacement may be more appropriate when the appliance has repeated major failures, extensive corrosion or damage, unavailable parts or a repair cost close to the price of a comparable new appliance.

What should I do if the appliance is still covered by Samsung’s manufacturer warranty?

Bring the proof of purchase and the appliance’s full model code to the visit, so the warranty position can be confirmed before any chargeable work begins.

Where the fault is covered by the manufacturer’s warranty, the repair is handled under those terms rather than charged as a private repair.

Facing an issue with your Samsung appliance?

What to expect

### What Customers Can Expect from Our Repair Service

#### Appliance-Specific Inspection

The technician checks the appliance model and investigates the systems connected to the reported problem. The purpose of the inspection is to identify the fault rather than assume that a commonly replaced component is responsible.

Different faults can create similar symptoms. For example, a washing machine that does not spin may have a drainage problem, an unbalanced load, a door-lock fault or a problem with the drive system. Testing helps separate these possibilities.

#### On-Site Repairs Where Practical

Washing machines, refrigerators, air conditioners, dishwashers, dryers, ovens and cooking ranges are generally inspected where they are installed.

A workshop visit may be necessary when the repair requires specialist test equipment, prolonged observation or work that cannot be completed safely inside the property. The reason for removing the appliance should be explained before collection is arranged.

#### Parts Matched to the Appliance Model

Any replacement component should be selected according to the full model code and the confirmed fault. The proposed part and its cost are explained before installation.

The service record states the genuine Samsung part supplied, with its part description, so the customer has a written record of what went into the appliance.

#### Approval Before Major Work

The customer receives an explanation of the fault and the proposed repair before major work begins. The estimate may include diagnosis, labour, parts and any workshop or transportation charges that apply.

If additional damage is discovered during the repair, the revised work and cost should be discussed before proceeding.

#### Testing After Repair

The repaired function is tested before the service is considered complete. Depending on the appliance, this may include checking cooling, heating, water filling, drainage, spinning, drum movement, door operation, ignition or control-panel response.

Testing confirms whether the original symptom has been resolved at the time of the visit. It does not guarantee that an unrelated component will not fail later.

#### Written Service Information

The invoice or service record should identify the appliance, the reported problem, the work completed and any part supplied.

Where a repair is covered by a three-month warranty, the covered work, covered component and relevant exclusions should be stated clearly on the invoice. The warranty should not be presented as applying to unrelated faults or damage outside the original repair.

### We Repair Every Common Samsung Washing Machine Problem

- #### Washing machine does not turn on

The technician checks the power supply, plug, internal wiring, noise filter, control module and door-lock circuit to identify why the machine remains unresponsive.

- #### Machine turns on but does not start

A Samsung washer may refuse to begin a cycle when the door lock, control panel, water supply or programme system develops a fault. We test each related component before replacing parts.

- #### Water does not enter the drum

Blocked inlet filters, low water pressure, damaged hoses, faulty inlet valves and sensor problems can stop the machine from filling. Our team identifies and repairs the exact restriction.

- #### Washing machine does not drain

Standing water often points to a blocked filter, restricted drain hose, damaged pump or electrical fault. We clear the drainage path and test the pump under operating conditions.

- #### Drum does not spin

A non-spinning drum may result from drainage failure, an unbalanced load, a worn drive system, motor damage or control-board trouble. The technician tests the full spin system.

- #### Washer shakes or moves during spinning

Incorrect levelling, worn suspension parts, damaged shock absorbers or an unstable floor can cause excessive movement. We inspect the installation and internal support system.

- #### Water leaks from the machine

Leaks can develop around the door seal, detergent drawer, inlet hose, drain hose, pump housing or internal connections. We trace the leak to its source instead of sealing the visible area alone.

- #### Door does not lock or open

A faulty lock, damaged handle, trapped water or control issue can keep the door closed or prevent a cycle from starting. Our technicians release and repair the mechanism safely.

- #### Washing machine makes loud noises

Grinding, banging, scraping and humming sounds can indicate foreign objects, bearing wear, pump trouble, drum damage or loose internal parts. We inspect the machine before the fault causes further damage.

- #### Clothes remain wet after the cycle

Poor drainage, low spin speed, load imbalance, motor problems or programme faults can leave laundry soaked. We test both the drainage and spinning systems.

- #### Machine displays an error code

Samsung washing machines use error codes to report water, drainage, door, motor, heating and communication faults. We interpret the code and confirm its cause through physical testing.

- #### Washing cycle stops halfway

A cycle may stop because of water-supply trouble, overheating, drainage failure, sensor errors or an electronic control problem. We test the stage at which the programme fails.

- #### Washer does not heat the water

A damaged heating element, temperature sensor, wiring connection or control relay can prevent the selected programme from reaching the required temperature.

- #### Detergent remains in the drawer

Low water pressure, blocked dispenser channels, incorrect detergent or inlet-valve problems can prevent proper detergent flow. We clean and repair the affected system.

- #### Washing machine has a burning smell

A burning smell requires immediate attention. Motor strain, damaged wiring, belt friction or an overheating electrical component can create a safety risk. Switch off the appliance and contact our service team.

### Certified Samsung Refrigerator and Freezer Repair Specialists

Samsung refrigerators rely on several systems working together. The compressor creates cooling, fans circulate cold air, sensors monitor temperature, and the defrost system prevents ice from blocking airflow. A failure in one area often affects the performance of the entire appliance.

Our technicians understand how these components interact. They do not assume that every cooling problem comes from low gas or a failed compressor. A warm refrigerator may have a blocked air vent, frozen evaporator, faulty fan, damaged sensor, failed heater or control-board issue.

Each inspection follows the condition of the appliance. The technician checks temperature readings, fan operation, frost patterns, door sealing, drainage and electrical response before recommending a repair. This method prevents unnecessary part replacement and gives the customer a reliable answer.

### We Repair Every Common Samsung Refrigerator and Freezer Problem

- #### Refrigerator is not cooling

A failed fan, sensor, compressor component, control board or blocked airflow path can prevent the cabinet from reaching the selected temperature. We inspect the full cooling cycle before deciding which part requires attention.

- #### Freezer is not freezing

Soft food and melting ice often point to airflow trouble, excessive frost, a damaged door seal, sensor failure or a sealed-system fault. Our technicians test the freezer temperature and cooling response to locate the cause.

- #### Refrigerator is warm but freezer stays cold

This problem usually develops when cold air cannot move from the freezer into the refrigerator compartment. We check the evaporator fan, air damper, vents and frost level behind the internal panel.

- #### Freezer is cold but food keeps thawing

An unstable temperature can result from a weak compressor, faulty sensor, damaged seal or repeated defrost interruption. We monitor the cooling cycle instead of relying on a single temperature reading.

- #### Ice builds up inside the freezer

Heavy frost can block air circulation and reduce cooling throughout the appliance. Our team checks the defrost heater, thermal fuse, sensor, drain and control system to identify why the ice keeps returning.

- #### Water leaks onto the floor

A blocked defrost drain, cracked water line, loose connection or overflowing drain tray can cause water to collect beneath the refrigerator. We trace the leak to its source and repair the affected part.

- #### Water collects inside the refrigerator

Moisture under the drawers or along the back wall often comes from a blocked drainage channel, damaged seal or temperature imbalance. The technician clears the restriction and checks the surrounding components.

- #### Refrigerator runs continuously

A refrigerator that never rests may struggle with dirty coils, poor ventilation, warm air entering through the door or a cooling-system fault. We inspect both operating conditions and internal components.

- #### Refrigerator makes loud or unusual noises

Buzzing, knocking, rattling or grinding can come from the compressor, condenser fan, evaporator fan, ice maker or loose internal parts. We identify the sound under operation before carrying out the repair.

- #### Ice maker does not produce ice

Low water flow, a frozen inlet tube, faulty valve, damaged sensor or ice-maker assembly can stop production. Our technicians check the water supply and electrical controls before replacing the unit.

- #### Water dispenser stops working

A blocked filter, frozen line, weak inlet pressure, failed valve or control fault can interrupt the dispenser. We test the water path from the supply connection to the outlet.

- #### Refrigerator door does not close properly

Misaligned hinges, overloaded shelves, damaged seals or an uneven appliance can leave the door slightly open. This forces the cooling system to work harder and allows moisture to enter the cabinet.

- #### Display panel shows an error code

Samsung refrigeration error codes can point to fan, sensor, communication, defrost or power faults. We use the code as a diagnostic clue and confirm the actual failure through testing.

- #### Refrigerator has no power

The fault may involve the socket, cable, internal fuse, power board or main control module. Our technicians check the electrical supply and appliance circuits safely.

- #### Food freezes inside the refrigerator compartment

A damaged temperature sensor, blocked vent, faulty damper or incorrect airflow can expose fresh food to excessive cold. We inspect the temperature-control system and restore balanced cooling.

### We Repair Every Common Samsung AC Problem

- #### Samsung AC does not turn on

A power-supply issue, damaged cable, faulty control board, failed capacitor or remote-control problem can stop the unit from starting. We test the electrical circuit and control system to locate the fault.

- #### AC runs but does not cool

- #### Cooling is weak during the afternoon

Strong daytime heat exposes problems that remain hidden during cooler hours. Restricted airflow, dirty outdoor coils, low refrigerant pressure or poor compressor performance can reduce cooling when demand rises.

- #### Indoor unit leaks water

- #### Ice forms on the indoor coil

- #### Outdoor unit does not start

A failed capacitor, damaged contactor, wiring fault, control-board issue or compressor problem can prevent the outdoor unit from operating. We test each component under safe conditions.

- #### AC switches off repeatedly

- #### AC produces an unpleasant smell

- #### AC trips the circuit breaker

Samsung AC error codes can indicate sensor, fan, communication, refrigerant or electrical faults. Our technicians read the code and confirm the failure through physical testing.

Poor air distribution can result from blocked vents, incorrect fan speed, dirty filters, duct leakage or installation issues. We inspect airflow and temperature across the room.

- #### Samsung AC consumes too much electricity

### We Repair Every Common Samsung Microwave Oven Problem

- #### Microwave does not turn on

A failed fuse, damaged power cable, faulty socket, door-switch problem or control-board fault can leave the appliance completely unresponsive. We inspect the power and safety circuits before replacing components.

- #### Microwave runs but does not heat

The appliance may sound normal while the food remains cold. Common causes include a failed magnetron, high-voltage diode, capacitor, transformer or control relay. Our technicians test the full heating circuit safely.

- #### Microwave stops after a few seconds

A cooling-fan fault, overheating component, damaged door switch or electrical overload can interrupt operation shortly after the cycle begins. We observe the shutdown pattern and test the related system.

- #### Microwave sparks inside

Metal objects, damaged enamel, burnt food residue, a broken waveguide cover or an internal electrical fault can produce sparks. Stop using the appliance and arrange an inspection before the cavity suffers further damage.

- #### Turntable does not rotate

A damaged turntable motor, worn coupler, broken roller ring or control fault can stop the tray from moving. We inspect the mechanical drive and electrical supply to the motor.

- #### Microwave makes a loud buzzing sound

A strong buzz can come from the magnetron, transformer, cooling fan or high-voltage circuit. The appliance requires immediate inspection when the sound appears with poor heating or a burning smell.

- #### Door does not close properly

A damaged latch, misaligned hinge, bent frame or worn door component can prevent the safety switches from engaging. The microwave will not operate correctly until the door closes securely.

- #### Microwave starts when the door closes

This behaviour points to a control-board, relay or door-switch fault and requires urgent attention. Disconnect the appliance and contact a trained technician.

- #### Display remains blank

- #### Interior light does not work

A burnt bulb, damaged holder, door-switch fault or control issue can leave the cavity dark. We replace the correct component and confirm safe operation.

- #### Microwave produces a burning smell

Burnt food residue, overheated wiring, damaged insulation or a failing electrical component can create a strong odour. Switch off the appliance immediately and avoid further use.

- #### Food heats unevenly

A stationary turntable, weak magnetron output, incorrect sensor response or internal distribution fault can leave cold areas in food. We test heating performance and the systems responsible for even energy distribution.

- #### Microwave displays an error code

Samsung microwave error codes can indicate sensor, keypad, communication, cooling or heating faults. Our technicians use the code as a diagnostic reference and confirm the actual failure through testing.

- #### Microwave trips the circuit breaker

Damaged wiring, a shorted component, failed high-voltage part or moisture inside the appliance can trip the breaker. This fault carries an electrical risk and requires professional inspection.

### We Repair Every Common Samsung Cooking Range and Oven Problem

Samsung ovens use error codes to report sensor, fan, communication, temperature and control problems. We read the code and confirm the failure through testing.

- #### Cooking appliance smells of gas or burning

A gas smell, smoke or burning electrical odour requires immediate action. Turn off the appliance, close the gas supply where safe and contact our service team. Do not continue using the unit.

### What Our Complete Inspection and Service Includes

A complete inspection looks beyond the component that appears to have failed. The technician checks how the appliance receives power, water, drainage, airflow or gas, depending on the product. Water-using appliances are examined for restricted inlet flow, blocked drainage, worn seals, loose connections and internal leakage. The service may involve adjustment, cleaning, repair or component replacement, depending on what the inspection reveals. Parts are not added to the repair simply because they are commonly associated with a particular symptom. Dishwashers, dryers, microwaves and air conditioners are tested through the operating functions connected to the completed repair. The job is considered complete only after the appliance has been rechecked and the customer has received an explanation of the work.

These details help the technician inspect the relevant parts without making early assumptions. ### What Our Complete Inspection and Service May Include

The inspection is planned around the reported problem. It is not a fixed package in which every appliance receives the same checks.

Depending on the machine and its condition, the visit may include:

- Confirming the reported symptom
- Reading available error information
- Checking the plug, cable and visible power connection
- Inspecting water-inlet and drainage connections
- Looking for leakage or moisture damage
- Examining filters, vents and airflow paths
- Checking door seals, locks, hinges and switches
- Testing pumps, motors, fans and moving parts
- Inspecting heating components
- Checking temperature and water-level sensors
- Reviewing drum, belt or support movement
- Examining wiring and control connections
- Testing cooling performance
- Inspecting the installation area
- Identifying signs of overheating
- Checking for blocked or damaged hoses
- Replacing an approved component where available
- Reassembling the appliance correctly
- Testing the repaired function
- Explaining the completed work

The technician may also point out conditions that could cause the problem to return.

For example, replacing a damaged dishwasher hose without correcting the bend that placed pressure on it would leave the new hose exposed to the same strain. Repairing a dryer heater without addressing restricted airflow could result in repeated overheating.

A complete service therefore looks beyond the failed part. It considers how the component operates within the rest of the appliance and whether another condition contributed to the failure.

Customers should also receive a clear record of the repair. This may identify the appliance, reported fault, completed work and replacement component where applicable.

A home appliance does not always stop working without warning. A refrigerator may begin running for longer periods, a washing machine may leave water inside the drum, or an air conditioner may take more time to cool the room. These early changes deserve proper attention before the fault affects other components.

Our Samsung appliance repair service in Ajman provides inspection, fault diagnosis, maintenance, and repair support for commonly used household appliances. Customers can request assistance for Samsung washing machines, refrigerators, freezers, air conditioners, dishwashers, dryers, microwave ovens, and cooking appliances.

The inspection follows a sensible order, beginning with the reported problem and moving toward the systems connected to it.

This method is important because similar symptoms can develop for different reasons. Water beneath a washing machine may come from a loose hose, a damaged door seal, a blocked detergent drawer, or an internal connection. Weak refrigerator cooling may involve airflow, ice accumulation, a fan, a temperature sensor, or part of the cooling system.

### A Practical Choice for Samsung Appliances in Ajman, UAE

Selecting an appliance repair service should involve more than finding someone who can open the machine. The technician should understand how its parts work together, recognise the difference between a symptom and its cause, and communicate the findings without making the process unnecessarily complicated.

Modern Samsung appliances use a combination of mechanical parts, sensors, electrical connections, motors, pumps, heating systems, cooling components, and electronic controls. A fault in one section can influence several functions.

For example, a washing machine may refuse to spin because it has not drained completely. In that situation, replacing the motor would not solve the original problem. The technician first needs to determine whether the machine is holding water, whether the load is balanced, and whether the door-lock system is confirming that the appliance is safe to spin.

The same principle applies to an air conditioner that produces warm air. The cause may involve restricted airflow, a dirty coil, a fan problem, an inaccurate sensor, an electrical fault, or the refrigerant circuit. Adding refrigerant without examining the rest of the system would be an incomplete approach.

Our technicians inspect the appliance according to its actual condition rather than relying on a quick assumption. They consider the customer’s description, visible signs, error information, operating sounds, and test results before recommending work.

We also consider where and how the appliance has been installed. An enclosed refrigerator may struggle to release heat. A dishwasher drain hose may be positioned incorrectly. A dryer placed in a poorly ventilated space may take longer to dry clothes. A washing machine standing on an uneven surface may move excessively even when its internal supports are working.

Ajman includes apartment districts, villa communities, commercial buildings, and mixed residential areas. Our service coverage may include Al Nuaimiya, Al Rashidiya, Al Rawda, Al Jurf, Al Mowaihat, Al Hamidiya, Al Rumailah, Al Bustan, Al Nakheel, Al Zahya, Al Yasmeen, Al Helio, Al Alia, and surrounding communities.

Customers living in apartment buildings should mention reception procedures, visitor parking, lift access, and unit details during booking. Villa residents can also state whether the appliance is located in the main kitchen, an external kitchen, a utility room, or another part of the property.

These details may appear minor, but they help prevent delays and allow the technician to arrive with a clearer understanding of the working environment.

### Comprehensive Samsung Home Appliance Repair in Ajman

Our technicians adapt the service according to the appliance category, model, installation, and symptoms reported by the customer.

#### Samsung Washing Machine Repair in Ajman

A washing machine may develop a fault during filling, washing, draining, rinsing, or spinning. Knowing which stage is affected can narrow the inspection considerably.

We inspect Samsung front-load and top-load washing machines experiencing problems such as:

- The machine not switching on
- A wash programme failing to begin
- Water entering slowly or not entering
- Water remaining inside the drum

- The door refusing to lock or open

- Excessive shaking during operation
- Knocking, grinding, or humming sounds
- Water leaking from the front or underneath
- Detergent remaining inside the drawer
- The cycle stopping before completion
- An error code appearing on the display
- An unpleasant smell developing inside the drum

The technician may inspect the inlet hoses, water valves, detergent drawer, drain filter, drain pump, pressure system, door-lock assembly, drum supports, belt, motor, wiring, and electronic controls.

Not every problem requires a new part. A restricted drain hose, overloaded drum, unbalanced load, blocked filter, or unstable installation may affect operation without an internal component being permanently damaged.

Where a component has failed, the technician explains its purpose and how its condition relates to the reported problem. Approved repairs are followed by checks of the relevant wash, drain, or spin function.

Customers should stop using the washing machine when there is heavy leakage, a burning smell, visible electrical damage, or repeated tripping of the circuit breaker.

The technician may ask whether the refrigerator was recently moved, switched off, heavily loaded, or left open for an extended period. These circumstances can temporarily affect temperature and should be considered before declaring that a major part has failed.

After repair, a refrigerator may require several hours to return to its selected temperature. The technician explains which results can be confirmed during the visit and what the customer should monitor afterward.

A low refrigerant reading should lead to further investigation. Refrigerant does not normally disappear through routine operation, so the technician may need to consider whether a leak or previous service issue is present.

### How Our Samsung Appliance Repair Process Works

- #### Tell Us About the Appliance

The booking process begins with a clear description of the machine and its behaviour.
Customers should provide:

The appliance category

- The model number where available
- The Ajman service location
- The displayed error code
- The stage at which the fault occurs
- Any leakage, noise, smell, or overheating
- Whether the issue is constant or occasional
- Relevant building-access instructions

A photograph of the model label, display, or visible problem may help the technician understand the report.

- #### We Review the Information

The reported details are organised before the appointment. This allows the technician to consider which systems may require testing and which tools may be relevant.
The initial description helps with preparation, but it is not treated as a final diagnosis. A fault should be confirmed through inspection.

- #### We Arrange the Visit

The appointment is planned according to the area, technician route, appliance type, and available schedule.
Customers in towers or apartment buildings should arrange any required visitor registration. Clear parking, reception, lift, and unit details can reduce delays.
Where the appliance is built into cabinetry or installed in a restricted space, this should be mentioned before the visit.

- #### The Technician Confirms the Problem

At the property, the technician asks the customer to describe when and how the issue occurs. The appliance may then be operated where it is safe and useful to do so.
This stage helps confirm whether the fault is continuous, connected to a particular function, or influenced by the installation.

- #### The Relevant Components Are Inspected

The technician follows the appliance system connected to the symptom.
A machine that does not drain requires a different sequence of checks from one that leaks while filling. An AC with weak airflow requires a different assessment from a unit that does not receive power.
Focused inspection helps avoid unnecessary dismantling and unrelated part replacement.

- #### The Findings Are Explained

Once the likely cause has been established, the technician explains:

Which section has developed the fault

- How the fault affects operation
- Whether cleaning, adjustment, or replacement is needed
- Which component may be required
- Whether the repair can be completed immediately
- What testing will follow the work

The explanation should be understandable without requiring the customer to know technical terminology.

- #### The Customer Reviews the Proposed Work

The repair should proceed after the customer has reviewed the recommendation and expected cost.
If additional damage is found during dismantling or testing, it should be discussed before further chargeable work is added.

- #### The Approved Repair Is Carried Out

Where the required part and working conditions allow, the technician completes the approved repair during the visit.
Some cases require a second appointment because the exact component must be identified or sourced. Availability can depend on the appliance model, age, and part number.
A realistic update is more useful than promising first-visit completion before the machine has been inspected.

- #### The Appliance Is Tested

After reassembly, the technician checks the functions connected to the original fault.
Testing may involve:

Filling and draining a washing machine

- Checking drum movement
- Monitoring refrigerator airflow
- Confirming AC cooling and drainage
- Testing dishwasher circulation
- Checking dryer heat and rotation
- Confirming oven controls
- Testing microwave operation safely

A complete programme may not always be practical during the appointment, but the repaired function should be tested as far as the circumstances allow.

- #### Basic Care Information Is Provided

The technician explains any maintenance or operating point directly related to the repair.
This may include keeping filters clear, maintaining ventilation, avoiding overloaded cycles, checking hoses, using a suitable programme, or watching for the return of a specific warning sign.

- Looking for signs of overheating

- Explaining what work was completed

A proper inspection also considers whether another condition contributed to the failure.

For example, replacing an overheated dryer component without examining airflow could allow the new part to face the same strain. Repairing a leaking hose without checking why it was rubbing against the cabinet may only provide a temporary result.

The failed part and the conditions around it should therefore be considered together.

# Privacy Policy | Samsung Service Center UAE

URL: https://samsungservices-center.com/privacy/

## Privacy Policy

This policy explains what Samsung Service Center does with your personal information when you book a repair, contact us, or use this website. It applies to everyone we deal with in the UAE.

Last updated 31 July 2026

On this page

- Who is responsible for your data
- What we collect
- What we do not collect
- Why we are allowed to use it
- Who else sees it
- How long we keep it
- Your rights
- Keeping it safe
- Children
- Changes to this policy

### 01 Who is responsible for your data

Samsung Service Center, trading as [REGISTERED LEGAL NAME] under trade licence [LICENCE NUMBER], registered at [REGISTERED ADDRESS], is the controller of the personal data described here. That means we decide what is collected and why.

Questions about this policy, or about the data we hold on you, go to info@samsungservices-center.com or the phone number in the footer of this site.

### 02 What we collect

We collect only what a repair visit needs. In practice that is four things.

Contact and address details : your name, phone number, email address if you give one, and the address where the appliance is installed. Without these we cannot reach you or find the appliance.

Appliance and fault details : the appliance type, its full model code, the fault you have reported, and any photograph, video or error code you send us. This is what lets a technician arrive with the right part.

Service records : what was inspected, what was done, which part was supplied, the invoice, and the warranty position on that repair.

Basic website data : the pages you visited, the browser you used and a truncated IP address, recorded by our hosting provider in its server logs. The booking form also records the moment the page loaded, which is how automated spam submissions are rejected.

### 03 What we do not collect

This site sets no advertising or analytics cookies and loads nothing from a third-party domain. No tracking pixels, no embedded fonts, no social widgets. Nobody is profiling you here.

We do not ask for card details on this website. Payment is taken at the time of service.

### 04 Why we are allowed to use it

Contact, appliance and service data is processed because it is necessary to perform the repair contract you have asked us to carry out, and because we have a legitimate interest in keeping an accurate record of work done.

Invoices and service records are also kept because UAE law requires a business to retain its commercial records.

Where we want to use your details for anything else, a service reminder for example, we ask first, and you can withdraw that consent at any time without it affecting your repair.

### 05 Who else sees it

Your data is not sold, rented or traded. It is shared only where the repair cannot proceed without it:

Samsung , where a fault is being handled under the manufacturer's warranty and the claim has to be registered against your appliance.

Parts suppliers , who receive the model code and the part required, but not your contact details, unless a part is being delivered directly to you.

Our hosting provider , which stores this website and the messages sent through its booking form on servers it operates.

Authorities , where we are legally obliged to disclose something.

### 06 How long we keep it

Booking enquiries that do not turn into a visit are deleted within twelve months.

Service records and invoices are kept for the period UAE commercial law requires, currently five years, because a warranty claim or a tax query can arrive long after the repair.

Server logs are held for a short rolling period by the hosting provider and are not used to build any profile of you.

### 07 Your rights

Under UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data you can ask us to show you the data we hold, correct it if it is wrong, delete it where we have no ongoing reason to keep it, restrict or object to how we use it, or send it to you in a portable form.

Write to info@samsungservices-center.com. We reply within 30 days. There is no charge, and exercising any of these rights never affects the service you receive.

If you are not satisfied with our answer you can complain to the UAE Data Office.

### 08 Keeping it safe

This site is served over HTTPS with a strict content security policy, so the pages you see cannot load or send data to another domain.

Service records are accessible only to the technicians and office staff who need them. No security is absolute, and if a breach ever put your data at real risk we would tell you and the Data Office.

### 09 Children

This service is for adults arranging appliance repairs. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18, and if we learn that we have, it is deleted.

### 10 Changes to this policy

When this policy changes, the date at the foot of the page changes with it. A change that materially affects how your data is used will be brought to your attention rather than left for you to find.

# Terms of Service | Samsung Service Center UAE

URL: https://samsungservices-center.com/terms/

## Terms of Service

These terms apply when you book an appliance repair with Samsung Service Center. They set out what we will do, what it will cost, and what is and is not covered.

Last updated 31 July 2026

On this page

- Who these terms are between
- Booking a visit
- Inspection and estimate
- Your approval before work
- Parts
- Warranty
- Payment
- Cancelling or rescheduling
- Appliances taken to the workshop
- Gas and electrical safety
- What we are not liable for
- If something goes wrong
- Governing law
- Changes to these terms

### 01 Who these terms are between

They are an agreement between you, the customer, and Samsung Service Center, trading as [REGISTERED LEGAL NAME] under trade licence [LICENCE NUMBER].

Booking a visit by phone, WhatsApp, or the form on this site means you accept them.

### 02 Booking a visit

A booking is confirmed when we have the appliance type, its model code, the address and a contact number, and we have agreed a time window with you.

Time windows are estimates, not guarantees. Traffic and an earlier job running long are the usual reasons one slips; we will tell you if it does.

Someone aged 18 or over must be at the property for the whole visit, and the appliance must be reachable. A machine boxed in behind furniture or fitted units may need the visit rescheduled.

### 03 Inspection and estimate

Every job begins with an inspection. The technician tests the functions connected to the fault you reported and works out the cause before quoting.

A diagnostic charge may apply for that inspection, and it is told to you when you book, not after.

The estimate that follows may include diagnosis, labour, parts, and any workshop or transport charge. It is an estimate against the fault found, not a fixed price for anything else the appliance may turn out to need.

### 04 Your approval before work

No major work starts until you have approved the findings and the cost.

If dismantling reveals a second problem, we stop, explain it, and give you a revised figure. You decide whether it goes ahead.

You can decline the repair at that point. The diagnostic charge for the inspection already carried out remains payable.

### 05 Parts

Every part fitted is a genuine Samsung part, chosen against your appliance's model code rather than the appliance type.

The part supplied is written on your invoice, so you have a record of what went into the appliance.

Where a part is discontinued or unavailable we will tell you, and the repair may not be possible. Nothing is fitted without your agreement.

### 06 Warranty

Where a three-month warranty applies, it is stated on your invoice, and the invoice says which repair and which component it covers. If it is not on the invoice, it does not apply.

Within that period, a return of the same fault on the same component is put right at no further charge.

It does not extend to an unrelated fault, to a component we did not supply, to accidental damage, misuse, power surges, water ingress, pest damage, or to work carried out on the appliance by anyone else after our visit.

The manufacturer's own warranty, where the appliance is still inside it, runs on its own terms alongside this one.

### 07 Payment

Payment is due on completion of the approved work, unless we have agreed otherwise in writing before the visit.

You receive an invoice identifying the appliance, the reported fault, the work completed and any part supplied.

An appliance held at our workshop is released once the invoice for it is settled.

### 08 Cancelling or rescheduling

Change or cancel a booking by phone or WhatsApp. There is no charge if you do so before the technician sets out.

If nobody is at the property, or the appliance cannot be reached, a call-out charge may apply for the wasted visit.

### 09 Appliances taken to the workshop

Some faults need equipment or observation time that a home visit cannot provide. Where that is the case we explain why before the appliance is collected.

You are given a record of what was collected and its condition at the time.

Appliances not collected within 90 days of the repair being completed and you being notified may be disposed of to recover storage and repair costs.

### 10 Gas and electrical safety

Gas work is undertaken only where the appliance, its installation and the repair required can be handled safely and in line with applicable requirements.

If we find an installation we consider unsafe, we will say so and may decline to reconnect the appliance. That judgement is not negotiable and is made for your safety.

Microwave ovens hold a dangerous charge after being unplugged and are opened only by a technician equipped to do it.

### 11 What we are not liable for

We are responsible for the work we carry out and for damage we cause through our own negligence.

We are not responsible for a pre-existing fault we were not asked to repair, for the eventual failure of a component we did not touch, for food spoilage or consequential loss arising from an appliance breakdown, or for an appliance whose fault turns out to be uneconomic to repair.

Nothing here limits any liability that UAE law does not allow to be limited.

### 12 If something goes wrong

Tell us. Call, WhatsApp, or write to support@samsungservices-center.com with your invoice number and what has happened.

We acknowledge a complaint within two working days and aim to resolve it within ten.

### 13 Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates, and by the regulations of the Emirate of [EMIRATE]. The courts of that emirate have jurisdiction over any dispute.

### 14 Changes to these terms

The terms that apply to your repair are the ones published on the date you booked it. That date is at the foot of this page.
